editor_notes_for_email: Final score 8.25 after five revision rounds, against the round-4+ threshold of 7.7, so it ships. Artwork craft is 7.5, under the 8.5 craft floor; the owed craft cycle ran (7.0 to 7.5) and the five-round cap is reached. Slide 07's committee table is the weakest frame and still reads a little like a cog at thumb size. Every vote tally rests on one outlet, Alaska's News Source (KTUU, November 5th); muni.org returned 404, so the as-amended text is unread, and the quoted definition (08), the 'articulable operational needs' standard (03) and the 'within 30 days after' rail (04) are the September 15th text as filed, each labelled as filed ('after' is the fact-checker's reading of 'within 30 days of'). APD's use of AI is ADN's characterization. The cover never says Anchorage, so the caption's first line carries the place. The caption's closing question (memo to shorten, vote to lengthen) is a proposal, not a description of current law, and differs from slide 09's question; expect replies to treat it as a claim. Veterans Day is Wednesday November 11th, so post Tuesday or Thursday, 8 to 11 a.m. Alaska time.
